class.name: OcgGpCylinder
class.brief_description: Describes an infinite cylindrical surface. A cylinder is defined by its radius and positioned in space with a coordinate system (a gp_Ax3 object), the "main Axis" of which is the axis of the cylinder. This coordinate system is the "local coordinate system" of the cylinder. Note: when a gp_Cylinder cylinder is converted into a Geom_CylindricalSurface cylinder, some implicit properties of its local coordinate system are used explicitly: - its origin, "X Direction", "Y Direction" and "main Direction" are used directly to define the parametric directions on the cylinder and the origin of the parameters, - its implicit orientation (right-handed or left-handed) gives an orientation (direct or indirect) to the Geom_CylindricalSurface cylinder. See Also gce_MakeCylinder which provides functions for more complex cylinder constructions Geom_CylindricalSurface which provides additional functions for constructing cylinders and works, in particular, with the parametric equations of cylinders gp_Ax3

method.name: gp_Cylinder
method.description: Creates a indefinite cylinder.

method.name: SetAxis
method.description: Changes the symmetry axis of the cylinder. Raises ConstructionError if the direction of theA1 is parallel to the "XDirection" of the coordinate system of the cylinder.

method.name: SetLocation
method.description: Changes the location of the surface.

method.name: SetPosition
method.description: Change the local coordinate system of the surface.

method.name: SetRadius
method.description: Modifies the radius of this cylinder. Exceptions Standard_ConstructionError if theR is negative.

method.name: UReverse
method.description: Reverses the U parametrization of the cylinder reversing the YAxis.

method.name: VReverse
method.description: Reverses the V parametrization of the plane reversing the Axis.

method.name: Direct
method.description: Returns true if the local coordinate system of this cylinder is right-handed.

method.name: Axis
method.description: Returns the symmetry axis of the cylinder.

method.name: Coefficients
method.description: Computes the coefficients of the implicit equation of the quadric in the absolute cartesian coordinate system : theA1.X**2 + theA2.Y**2 + theA3.Z**2 + 2.(theB1.X.Y + theB2.X.Z + theB3.Y.Z) + 2.(theC1.X + theC2.Y + theC3.Z) + theD = 0.0

method.name: Location
method.description: Returns the "Location" point of the cylinder.

method.name: Position
method.description: Returns the local coordinate system of the cylinder.

method.name: Radius
method.description: Returns the radius of the cylinder.

method.name: XAxis
method.description: Returns the axis X of the cylinder.

method.name: YAxis
method.description: Returns the axis Y of the cylinder.

method.name: Mirrored_1
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of a cylinder with respect to the point theP which is the center of the symmetry.

method.name: Mirrored_2
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of a cylinder with respect to an axis placement which is the axis of the symmetry.

method.name: Mirrored_3
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of a cylinder with respect to a plane. The axis placement theA2 locates the plane of the of the symmetry : (Location, XDirection, YDirection).

method.name: Rotated
method.description: Rotates a cylinder. theA1 is the axis of the rotation. theAng is the angular value of the rotation in radians.

method.name: Scaled
method.description: Scales a cylinder. theS is the scaling value. The absolute value of theS is used to scale the cylinder

method.name: Transformed
method.description: Transforms a cylinder with the transformation theT from class Trsf.

method.name: Translated_1
method.description: Translates a cylinder in the direction of the vector theV. The magnitude of the translation is the vector's magnitude.

method.name: Translated_2
method.description: Translates a cylinder from the point theP1 to the point theP2.
